Feature: Greeting
  Background:
    Given a greeter named "world"

  Scenario Outline: Greet several times

    Then I see "Hello, world!"
    And the log has <times> lines

    Examples:
      | times |
      | 1     |
      | 3     |

  Scenario: Multi-line text
    Given the text
      """
      Hello,
      world
      """
